subject: In the modification indexes, what is the difference between ~~ and ~

messages.author: e588f32776429c73
messages.subject: In the modification indexes, what is the difference between ~~ and ~
parts:
What is the difference between ~~ and ~ in "op" column?

      lhs op    rhs      mi   epc sepc.lv sepc.all sepc.nox
10 bietra ~~ conago 119.344 2.872   2.872    1.147    1.147
11 bietra ~~ rentra 119.344 3.594   3.594    1.557    1.557
12 bietra ~~ jefhor 119.344 0.632   0.632    0.244    0.244
15 bietra  ~ jefhor 119.344 0.134   0.134    0.219    0.219
16 conago  ~ bietra 119.344 2.021   2.021    1.244    1.244
18 rentra  ~ bietra 119.345 2.529   2.529    1.704    1.704
20 jefhor  ~ bietra 119.344 0.444   0.444    0.272    0.272
